🎥🎬: How to Defend Yourself From a Woman at Night – Jett Fist (Lone Wolf Series)

In this hilarious self-defense comedy sketch, Jett Fist takes on an unusual nighttime scenario, offering his own over-the-top approach to defending yourself when confronted by a woman after dark. What sounds like a serious self-defense lesson quickly turns into an absurd demonstration filled with exaggerated reactions, unexpected moves and comedic confidence.

Blending martial arts parody with ridiculous situations, the sketch plays on the familiar self-defense tutorial format, turning an everyday encounter into an outrageous comedy lesson. Jett Fist’s unconventional methods and deadpan delivery make the entire scenario even more entertaining.
